g.text: read the labels on YOUR module: + / OUT(S) / -

svg.text: Smart Plant Monitor (Arduino Uno). Bright = do it now, faded = already done.
1. LED: LONG leg (+) in 20i, short leg (-) in 21i. Wire D6 -> 20j. Wire 21j -> BLUE (-) rail
2. Buzzer: + leg in 40f, - leg in 43f. Wire D12 -> 40j. Wire 43j -> BLUE (-) rail
LED ON when too dark. Buzzer beeps when humidity is below 40%.
